question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hideous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Repulsive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hideous"** means something that is very ugly or disgusting to look at; it provokes horror. (भयानक)

 
 
• **Example: **The monster in the movie was so hideous that it gave me nightmares for weeks.
 
 

 
• **"Repulsive" **refers to something that causes intense aversion or disgust; it is something that one finds particularly offensive or unacceptable. (घृणास्पद)

 
 
• **Example: **The sight of the spoiled food was so repulsive that it made me gag.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Hideous'** is **'Repulsive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Repulsive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pretty **(सुंदर): Pleasing or attractive to the eye, not causing horror or disgust.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden looked pretty with all the flowers in full bloom.
 
 

 
• **Attractive **(आकर्षक ): Pleasing or appealing to the senses.
 
 
• **Example: **The display was designed to be particularly attractive to young children.
 
 

 
• **Plain** (साधारण): Not decorated or elaborate; simple or ordinary in character.
 
 
• **Example:** She preferred wearing plain clothes without any flashy accessories.
